product.name: Electric Spray Air Cushion Massage Comb

sections.copy_summary: First-person advertorial header, bylined to Sarah Jenkins, an accountant and mother. Standing at the bathroom sink at 6:45 in the morning, every stroke of her plastic brush turns fine morning frizz into an unmanageable cloud of static. The headline calls it the morning static trap that turned brushing into a battle every single day.

The morning routine was falling apart. At the mirror before an early check-in she watches her hair flare into an electric halo with every brush stroke. Her manager notices her messy webcam angle during the Monday quarterly presentation while she keeps smoothing down runaway flyaways. The cost here is appearance and self-image at work, not physical pain.

When morning tears became routine. Last month her daughter burst into tears as rigid bristles snagged on a stubborn crown knot and they missed the primary school bus entirely; her husband had to take the brush from her trembling hand while the child sat on the hallway floor. This is the child pain beat and the one G13 governs.

Every quick solution only made it worse. Expensive leave-in oils and heavy silicone serums left fine roots flat and greasy by midday. A standard spray bottle left dripping wet spots that caused frizz patches instead of an even refresh. Three named alternatives that were bought and abandoned.

Why friction traps dry strands. Standard dry brushing creates severe surface friction that charges dry strands with static. Rigid plastic teeth scrape delicate scalp tissue and drag through fragile fibres rather than yielding to natural knots. The named mechanism is friction to charge to repulsion.

The gentle morning refresh. The comb combines an ultrasonic dry-touch nano-mist atomiser with a soft elastic cushion base and rounded massage bristles. Six integrated red LEDs illuminate the scalp while micro-vibrations distribute the fine mist evenly from roots to tips. A component list rather than a body-structure claim.

Peaceful mornings are back. Every school morning the daughter sits happily in her chair while the mist and the soft cushion work through overnight bedhead without a single whimper. The narrator's own routine takes barely two minutes before team video calls, leaving her hair smooth and static-free without a wash.

Three simple steps every morning. One, fill the compact built-in tank with clean water or a liquid essence. Two, turn on the mist and glide from the tips first, upward along the scalp. Three, press the one-click retractable button to release trapped loose hair.
